fabric.sequin_allover.contents: FULL SEQUIN COVERAGE. Entire dress surface covered in overlapping sequins. Every movement creates flash and shimmer. Disco ball effect - reflects light in every direction. MAXIMUM SPARKLE.

fabric.holographic_shift.contents: HOLOGRAPHIC FABRIC in DRESS COLOR. Surface shifts through lighter and darker variations of DRESS COLOR with iridescent shimmer at every angle. Prismatic sparkle overlaid on base color. MAXIMUM SHIMMER.

fabric.crystal_encrusted.contents: CRYSTAL-ENCRUSTED SURFACE. Rhinestones and crystals covering entire dress. Faceted stones catch light from every direction. Each crystal a point of brilliant sparkle. MAXIMUM JEWEL SHIMMER.

fabric.mirror_foil.contents: MIRROR FOIL FABRIC. Metallic surface reflects like liquid metal. Chrome-bright finish catches every light source. Reflects surroundings in warped shine. MAXIMUM METALLIC GLEAM.

fabric.glitter_tulle.contents: GLITTER TULLE. Sheer fabric embedded with dense glitter particles. Sparkle visible through transparent layers. Glitter catches light at every fold. Fairy dust shimmer throughout. MAXIMUM GLITTER.

fabric.rhinestone_mesh.contents: RHINESTONE MESH. Transparent mesh base completely covered in rhinestones. Grid of sparkling stones. Light hits create constellation effect. MAXIMUM STONE SPARKLE.

fabric.holographic_sequin.contents: HOLOGRAPHIC SEQUINS. Color-shifting sequins covering surface in DRESS COLOR. Each sequin shifts through lighter and darker variations with iridescent shimmer. Double sparkle - sequin flash plus color shift. MAXIMUM SPARKLE.

fabric.tinsel_knit.contents: TINSEL KNIT. Metallic lurex threads woven densely throughout fabric. Tinsel sparkle at every inch. Catches light like Christmas tree. MAXIMUM METALLIC THREAD SHIMMER.

fabric.beaded_allover.contents: BEADED FABRIC. Seed beads and crystals sewn densely across entire surface. Beads catch light creating shimmer field. Weight creates fluid drape with sparkle. MAXIMUM BEAD SHIMMER.

fabric.iridescent_organza.contents: IRIDESCENT ORGANZA. Sheer fabric in DRESS COLOR shifts through iridescent variations with light angle. Translucent shimmer with color play. Fairy wing iridescence. MAXIMUM COLOR-SHIFT SHEER.

fabric.sparkle_velvet.contents: SPARKLE VELVET. Plush velvet surface embedded with glitter particles. Soft texture with sparkle throughout. Light catches glitter in velvet pile. MAXIMUM LUXE SHIMMER.

fabric.disco_mirror.contents: DISCO MIRROR FABRIC. Small reflective tiles covering surface like disco ball. Each tile reflects light independently. Creates prismatic light beams. MAXIMUM DISCO SPARKLE.
